title: pvWriteEnSightWriter
body:
## pvWriteEnSightWriter

Explicit-export writer for EnSight Gold, the case format read by Ansys EnSight and many CFD post-processors: a .case index, a binary .geo geometry file and one file per point or cell array. It accepts only a single, non-composite unstructured grid; cells are grouped into EnSight parts by an integer BlockId cell array when present, otherwise everything is part 1. Publication uses the semantic contract: the case is read back and geometry plus every input point and cell field are compared, accepting changes in structure, point identity, connectivity order and storage type. Use pvWriteXMLUnstructuredGridWriter for lossless VTK storage, or pvWriteCGNSWriter / pvWriteIOSSWriter for other solver formats.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK names the case file data.0.case (0 is the process number); Schemaxis finds it automatically, but keep the .case, .geo and variable files together when moving them.
- Only arrays with 1, 3, 6 or 9 components (scalar, vector, symmetric or full tensor) get a valid case-file entry, and pixel or voxel cells are skipped; remove such arrays with pvPassArrays and avoid grids built directly from image data, or verification fails.
- Field-data arrays are not stored in EnSight, while semantic verification checks them; remove field data upstream if the input carries any.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `EnSightWriter`. Identity: `writers/EnSightWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ChooseArraysToWrite` | Explicitly choose which arrays to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `GhostLevel` | The number of ghost levels to include in the output file(s). Note that some writers (such as ExodusIIWriter and CGNSWriter) may not support writing ghost levels. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "semantic",
  "extensions": [
    "case"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteEnSightWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ]
}
```
